scope: golden-free Trust-Hub graph detection on previously inspected families
input: single 20-feature gate graph; no clean reference at inference
split: five locked leave-family-out folds, all variants of a family held together
pass_rule: graph_aggregate_logistic minus size_logistic has positive lower bound in a paired two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over 11 families, 10000 draws, seed 20261103

feature_rules.graph_aggregate: size plus 16 gate fractions, 16 gate-presence flags, and mean/std/max/p50/p90/p99 of four numeric node channels
feature_rules.local_fraction: size plus 16 gate fractions and fractions of nodes with controllability or observability distance >= 8 or >= 16; numeric channels are raw graph x columns 18 and 19
feature_rules.normalization: fit column mean and standard deviation on outer training fold only; clamp standardized values to [-8,8]
feature_rules.logistic: class-balanced L2 logistic, penalty 0.01, deterministic LBFGS

cautions: Development families already inspected; criterion is a resource gate, not confirmatory significance
Different synthesis flows may confound results
No node labels or functional attack verification are assumed
